targets.expr:
(
  (count(sum by (service_name) (rate(apm_calls_total{span_name="django.request", service_name=~"$service"}[5m]) > 0)) or vector(0))
  + (count(sum by (service_name) (rate(apm_calls_total{db_system="postgresql", service_name=~"$service"}[5m]) > 0)) or vector(0))
  + (count(sum by (service_name) (rate(apm_calls_total{db_system="redis", service_name=~"$service"}[5m]) > 0)) or vector(0))
  + (count(sum by (service_name) (rate(apm_calls_total{span_type="http", service_name=~"$service"}[5m]) or rate(apm_calls_total{http_method!="", span_name!="django.request", db_system="", service_name=~"$service"}[5m]) > 0)) or vector(0))
)

panels.description: Watchdog APM real-time anomaly detection. Evaluates trailing ${anomaly_window} traffic against 7-day median baseline to detect endpoint RPS surges exceeding +50%. Click to investigate in Watchdog section.

0.text: ✅ All Systems Normal — 0 Active Anomalies (All endpoints operating within baseline)

targets.expr: count(((max_over_time(sum by (service_name, http_route, http_method) (rate(apm_calls_total{span_name="django.request", service_name=~"$service"}[$anomaly_window]))[$__range:1m]) - quantile_over_time(0.5, sum by (service_name, http_route, http_method) (rate(apm_calls_total{span_name="django.request", service_name=~"$service"}[$anomaly_window]))[7d:1h])) / quantile_over_time(0.5, sum by (service_name, http_route, http_method) (rate(apm_calls_total{span_name="django.request", service_name=~"$service"}[$anomaly_window]))[7d:1h]) > 0.001) * 100 > 50) or vector(0)

panels.description: Dynamically detected components from telemetry. Shows only components with active traffic. Click a component name to open its dedicated dashboard.

targets.expr:
label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum(rate(apm_calls_total{span_name="django.request", service_name=~"$service"}[$__range])), "Component", "Django", "", ""), "Type", "Web Framework", "", ""), "Dashboard", "/d/tracenest-django-overview", "", "")
or
label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (db_instance) (rate(apm_calls_total{db_system="postgresql", db_instance!="", service_name=~"$service"}[$__range])), "Component", "PostgreSQL ($1)", "db_instance", "(.*)"), "Type", "Database", "", ""), "Dashboard", "/d/tracenest-postgres-overview", "", "")
or
label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum(rate(apm_calls_total{db_system="postgresql", db_instance="", service_name=~"$service"}[$__range])), "Component", "PostgreSQL (default)", "", ""), "Type", "Database", "", ""), "Dashboard", "/d/tracenest-postgres-overview", "", "")
or
label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum(rate(apm_calls_total{server_address="pgbouncer", service_name=~"$service"}[$__range]) or rate(apm_calls_total{server_port="6432", service_name=~"$service"}[$__range])), "Component", "PgBouncer", "", ""), "Type", "Connection Pooler", "", ""), "Dashboard", "/d/tracenest-postgres-overview", "", "")
or
label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum(rate(apm_calls_total{db_system="redis", service_name=~"$service"}[$__range])), "Component", "Redis", "", ""), "Type", "Cache", "", ""), "Dashboard", "/d/tracenest-redis-overview", "", "")
or
label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum(rate(apm_calls_total{span_type="http", service_name=~"$service"}[$__range]) or rate(apm_calls_total{http_method!="", span_name!="django.request", db_system="", service_name=~"$service"}[$__range])), "Component", "Requests", "", ""), "Type", "HTTP Client", "", ""), "Dashboard", "/d/tracenest-django-overview", "", "")

sum by (Component, Error_Rate) (
  (
    label_replace(((sum(rate(apm_calls_total{span_name="django.request", service_name=~"$service", error="true"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / (sum(rate(apm_calls_total{span_name="django.request", service_name=~"$service"}[$__range])) > 0)) * 100, "Component", "Django", "", ""))
  or
  (
    label_replace(((sum by (db_instance) (rate(apm_calls_total{db_system="postgresql", db_instance!="", service_name=~"$service", error="true"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / (sum by (db_instance) (rate(apm_calls_total{db_system="postgresql", db_instance!="", service_name=~"$service"}[$__range])) > 0)) * 100, "Component", "PostgreSQL ($1)", "db_instance", "(.*)"))
  or
  (
    label_replace(((sum(rate(apm_calls_total{db_system="postgresql", db_instance="", service_name=~"$service", error="true"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / (sum(rate(apm_calls_total{db_system="postgresql", db_instance="", service_name=~"$service"}[$__range])) > 0)) * 100, "Component", "PostgreSQL (default)", "", ""))
  or
  (
    label_replace(((sum(rate(apm_calls_total{db_system="redis", service_name=~"$service", error="true"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / (sum(rate(apm_calls_total{db_system="redis", service_name=~"$service"}[$__range])) > 0)) * 100, "Component", "Redis", "", ""))
  or
  (
    label_replace(((sum(rate(apm_calls_total{span_type="http", service_name=~"$service", error="true"}[$__range]) or rate(apm_calls_total{http_method!="", span_name!="django.request", db_system="", service_name=~"$service", error="true"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / (sum(rate(apm_calls_total{span_type="http", service_name=~"$service"}[$__range]) or rate(apm_calls_total{http_method!="", span_name!="django.request", db_system="", service_name=~"$service"}[$__range])) > 0)) * 100, "Component", "Requests", "", ""))
)

sum by (Component, P95_Latency) (
  label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(apm_duration_milliseconds_bucket{span_name="django.request", service_name=~"$service"}[$__range])) by (le)), "Component", "Django", "", "")
  or
  label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, db_instance) (rate(apm_duration_milliseconds_bucket{db_system="postgresql", db_instance!="", service_name=~"$service"}[$__range]))), "Component", "PostgreSQL ($1)", "db_instance", "(.*)")
  or
  label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(apm_duration_milliseconds_bucket{db_system="postgresql", db_instance="", service_name=~"$service"}[$__range])) by (le)), "Component", "PostgreSQL (default)", "", "")
  or
  label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(apm_duration_milliseconds_bucket{db_system="redis", service_name=~"$service"}[$__range])) by (le)), "Component", "Redis", "", "")
  or
  label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(apm_duration_milliseconds_bucket{span_type="http", service_name=~"$service"}[$__range]) or rate(apm_duration_milliseconds_bucket{http_method!="", span_name!="django.request", db_system="", service_name=~"$service"}[$__range])) by (le)), "Component", "Requests", "", "")
)

sum by (Component, Total_Calls) (
  label_replace(sum(increase(apm_calls_total{span_name="django.request", service_name=~"$service"}[$__range])), "Component", "Django", "", "")
  or
  label_replace(sum by (db_instance) (increase(apm_calls_total{db_system="postgresql", db_instance!="", service_name=~"$service"}[$__range])), "Component", "PostgreSQL ($1)", "db_instance", "(.*)")
  or
  label_replace(sum(increase(apm_calls_total{db_system="postgresql", db_instance="", service_name=~"$service"}[$__range])), "Component", "PostgreSQL (default)", "", "")
  or
  label_replace(sum(increase(apm_calls_total{db_system="redis", service_name=~"$service"}[$__range])), "Component", "Redis", "", "")
  or
  label_replace(sum(increase(apm_calls_total{span_type="http", service_name=~"$service"}[$__range]) or increase(apm_calls_total{http_method!="", span_name!="django.request", db_system="", service_name=~"$service"}[$__range])), "Component", "Requests", "", "")
)

targets.expr: clamp_min(((sum(rate(apm_duration_milliseconds_sum{span_name="django.request", service_name=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval])) - (sum(rate(apm_duration_milliseconds_sum{db_system="postgresql", service_name=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]) or vector(0)) + sum(rate(apm_duration_milliseconds_sum{db_system="redis", service_name=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]) or vector(0)) + sum(rate(apm_duration_milliseconds_sum{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT", http_method!="", service_name=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]) or vector(0)) + sum(rate(apm_duration_milliseconds_sum{span_name=~"S3.*", service_name=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]) or vector(0)))) / (sum(rate(apm_duration_milliseconds_sum{span_name="django.request", service_name=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)) * 100, 0)
